customerJobs.title: Live Catalogs
customerJobs.note: Show buyers live catalogs, negotiated quotes, and new lines without maintaining parallel price lists in chat or spreadsheets.

customerJobs.title: Capture Every Order Mode
customerJobs.note: Take walk-in or trade bills, shop checkout, catalog negotiation, pre-order costing files, or dropship to a recipient.

customerJobs.title: Inbound & Warehouse
customerJobs.note: Track shipments, receive into warehouse lots, bin and grade stock, and fulfill picks.

customerJobs.title: Dropship Operations
customerJobs.note: Reseller buys at wholesale; the company ships to the end customer. Courier remittance and reseller profit stay separate from COD face.

customerJobs.title: Money & Capital
customerJobs.note: Customer bills and collections, supplier AP from landed shipments, cashbook leftover, and read-only investor visibility on shipment profit share.

pains.title: Overselling
pains.note: The same parent stock backs wholesale desk, shop carts, and dropship picks.

pains.title: Quote Chaos
pains.note: Custom and quote specs live in email while fulfillment runs in another tool.

pains.title: Inbound Blind Spots
pains.note: Promising dates without knowing what is in transit, received, or still on a costing file.

pains.title: Finance Lies
pains.note: Treating COD as sales, mixing dropship merchant totals with recipient cash, or editing issued invoices instead of credit notes.

pains.title: Stale Catalogs
pains.note: Each shop or customer group needs different prices, visibility, or negotiation rules.

gains.title: One Picture
gains.note: Open shipments, warehouse lots, shop orders, bills due, and cash in — with sales, cash, and COD defined the same way in reports.

gains.title: No Re-Keying
gains.note: Sell standard, negotiated, pre-order, and dropship flows without copying SKU and party into separate systems.

gains.title: Defensible Cost
gains.note: Unit cost from inbound pays and locked shipment costs; gross profit from shipment P&L, not guessed invoice-line COGS.

gains.title: Faster Close
gains.note: Confirmed demand to pick, ship, bill, and collect — including Delivery paper close for pre-orders.

gains.title: Self-Serve Shops
gains.note: Buyers use the right shop with the right prices and stock-backed availability.

productsAndServices.title: Warehouse Kernel
productsAndServices.note: Parent warehouse lots, bin tree, movements, FIFO issue on bills and shop picks.

productsAndServices.title: Shop & Catalogs
productsAndServices.note: Multiple shops per tenant; vendor catalog, fixed price, and dropship types; group pricing and listing visibility.

productsAndServices.title: Order Capture
productsAndServices.note: Wholesale compose (take / condition / walk-in); shop carts and negotiation; pre-order costing (PBC) and demand desk.

productsAndServices.title: Inbound & Landed Cost
productsAndServices.note: Shipment lifecycle, cost buckets, AP bills per bucket × currency, lock and restamp from pays.

productsAndServices.title: Money Kernel
productsAndServices.note: Bills, pays, allocations, profile cashbook; dropship remittance and merchant leftover payout.

productsAndServices.title: Access & Investor
productsAndServices.note: Parent/child tenants, four login scopes (platform, app, shop, investor); investor portal read-only on shipment share.

painRelievers.title: One Warehouse Quantity
painRelievers.note: Shop holds and pick lines debit the same lots; server-side issue and pick RPCs enforce availability — no channel-by-channel stock books.

painRelievers.title: Quote to Demand
painRelievers.note: PBC files and catalog negotiation lock confirmed qty into demand; Delivery paper close issues take or condition bills through the money kernel.

painRelievers.title: Shipment Statuses
painRelievers.note: Draft through received; post-to-stock from sellable lines; demand and backlog tie to profiles before goods are on hand.

painRelievers.title: Bills, Pays, Cashbook
painRelievers.note: Merchant AR at ship, net remittance pay-in, leftover on profile cashbook; investor share on shipment investments, not a shadow ledger.

painRelievers.title: Per-Shop Listings
painRelievers.note: Markup rules, group hides, and dropship floor prices; staff catalog browse separate from the customer shop.

gainCreators.title: Locked Money Layers
gainCreators.note: Reporting treasury reads sales vs cash vs COD vs AR; staff dashboard attention queue deep-links into desks.

gainCreators.title: Modules on One Parent
gainCreators.note: Child brands and new dropship or catalog shops without splitting warehouse or cashbook.

gainCreators.title: Shipment P&L
gainCreators.note: Landed and local costs; portal shows partner share on batches — collections stay on staff money desks.

gainCreators.title: Receive to Pick
gainCreators.note: Inbound milestones feed lots and unit stamp; dropship processing picks against those lots then ship+issue in one step.
